problem: Copy a genuine rectilinear angle onto any given nonzero base ray at its starting point.

proof_idea.original: Choose points on the source arms, join them, construct an equal-sided triangle using I.22 on the given line, then identify its angle using I.8 (SSS).
proof_idea.analytic: Use the dot product and signed determinant of the source arms, divided by the positive squared first-arm norm, to transform the second arm onto the target base frame. Its determinant stays nonzero; positive norm scaling preserves the signed cosine relation.

# Book I.23: copy a genuine rectilinear angle onto a given nonzero base ray.
# Euclid constructs an equal-sided triangle using I.22 and then invokes SSS.
# Here a direct similarity sends the first source arm to the prescribed base;
# its dot/norm laws prove equal angles without assuming a circle intersection.
thm proposition_23:
    ? forall a, b, d, c, e1 cart(R, R):
        a != b
        $geometry::main::is_triangle(c, d, e1)
        =>:
            exist g cart(R, R) st {$geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, g), $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(b, a, g, d, c, e1)}
    release thm geometry_lemmas::triangle_vertices_distinct(c, d, e1)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(c, d)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(c, e1)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(a, b)
    have k R+ = geometry::main::distance_sq(c, d)
    have v R+ = geometry::main::distance_sq(c, e1)
    have h R+ = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b)
    have ux R = d(1) - c(1)
    have uy R = d(2) - c(2)
    have vx R = e1(1) - c(1)
    have vy R = e1(2) - c(2)
    have wx R = b(1) - a(1)
    have wy R = b(2) - a(2)
    have n R = ux * vx + uy * vy
    have z R = ux * vy - uy * vx
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(c, d)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(c, e1)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, b)
    k = ux^2 + uy^2
    v = vx^2 + vy^2
    h = wx^2 + wy^2
    n^2 + z^2 = (ux * vx + uy * vy)^2 + (ux * vy - uy * vx)^2 = (ux^2 + uy^2) * (vx^2 + vy^2) = k * v
    release thm geometry::main::collinear_det_expand(c, d, e1)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(c, d), geometry::main::vec(c, e1)) = ux * vy - uy * vx = z
    z != 0
    have gx R = (n * wx - z * wy) / k
    have gy R = (n * wy + z * wx) / k
    have g cart(R, R) = (a(1) + gx, a(2) + gy)
    g(1) - a(1) = gx
    g(2) - a(2) = gy
    release thm geometry::main::collinear_det_expand(a, b, g)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, g)) = wx * gy - wy * gx = wx * ((n * wy + z * wx) / k) - wy * ((n * wx - z * wy) / k) = z * (wx^2 + wy^2) / k = z * h / k
    by contra:
        ? z * h / k != 0
        z * h / k = 0
        z = (z * h / k) * (k / h) = 0 * (k / h) = 0
        impossible z != 0
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, g)) != 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, g)
    release thm geometry_lemmas::triangle_vertices_distinct(a, b, g)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, g)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(a, g) = gx^2 + gy^2 = ((n * wx - z * wy) / k)^2 + ((n * wy + z * wx) / k)^2 = (n^2 + z^2) * (wx^2 + wy^2) / k^2 = (k * v) * h / k^2 = v * h / k
    release thm geometry::main::perpendicular_dot_expand(a, b, a, g)
    geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, g)) = wx * gx + wy * gy = wx * ((n * wx - z * wy) / k) + wy * ((n * wy + z * wx) / k) = n * (wx^2 + wy^2) / k = n * h / k
    release thm geometry::main::perpendicular_dot_expand(c, d, c, e1)
    geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(c, d), geometry::main::vec(c, e1)) = ux * vx + uy * vy = n
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(b, a, g) = n * h / k
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(d, c, e1) = n
    v * h > 0
    h / k > 0
    (v * h) * (h / k) > 0
    v * h^2 / k = (v * h) * (h / k) > 0
    geometry::main::angle_cos_den(b, a, g) = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b) * geometry::main::distance_sq(a, g) = h * (v * h / k) = v * h^2 / k
    geometry::main::angle_cos_den(b, a, g) > 0
    geometry::main::angle_cos_den(d, c, e1) = k * v > 0
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(b, a, g)^2 * geometry::main::angle_cos_den(d, c, e1) = (n * h / k)^2 * (k * v) = n^2 * (v * h^2 / k) = geometry::main::angle_cos_num(d, c, e1)^2 * geometry::main::angle_cos_den(b, a, g)
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(b, a, g) * geometry::main::angle_cos_num(d, c, e1) = (n * h / k) * n = n^2 * (h / k) >= 0
    by def $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(b, a, g, d, c, e1)
    witness exist gg cart(R, R) st {$geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, gg), $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(b, a, gg, d, c, e1)} from g
